ApiReasoningAlwaysOn.description: No request turns reasoning off; the checkpoint may still skip it on a turn.
ApiReasoningAlwaysOn.title: ApiReasoningAlwaysOn

ApiReasoningEffortLevels.description:
The request names one of ``levels`` at ``key``; another value may be refused.

``default`` is the level in force when the request names none. Only the
names a client chooses from are listed: an engine's own numeric scale behind
them (an integer or float alias) is not.
ApiReasoningEffortLevels.title: ApiReasoningEffortLevels

ApiReasoningEffortText.description:
The route takes any string at ``key`` (the template writes it into the prompt).

``default`` is the text in force when the request sets none; ``null`` when
then no effort is written and the checkpoint decides.
ApiReasoningEffortText.title: ApiReasoningEffortText

ApiReasoningSwitch.description:
Thinking can be turned on and off per request.

``keys`` are the alternative request keys the route reads (any one works);
``default`` is what the route does when the request says nothing, and
``model`` when the checkpoint decides.
ApiReasoningSwitch.title: ApiReasoningSwitch

ApiRemainingContext.description: No server default: the request may use what the context still holds.
ApiRemainingContext.title: ApiRemainingContext

ApiTokenArgument.description:
The server default is the value of this runtime argument.

The number is never copied here: it is read from the recipe's arguments (as
the option choice in force sets them), so it cannot drift from the launch.
ApiTokenArgument.title: ApiTokenArgument

ApiTokenSetting.description: Bound to the recipe setting of the same name, as ``RecipeRuntimeArgument``.
ApiTokenSetting.title: ApiTokenSetting

ApiToolsSupported.description:
Function calling works.

``tool_choice`` lists the choices the route enforces. ``none`` is always
honoured, so it is implied and never listed. An empty list means non-auto
choices are accepted but not enforced (a prompt nudge, or ignored). An
unlisted value may be refused (HTTP 400).
ApiToolsSupported.title: ApiToolsSupported

AudioSpeechApi.description:
A route serving ``POST /v1/audio/speech``: text in, audio bytes out.

``voices`` are the values of OpenAI's ``voice`` parameter; the first is the
route's health-check voice. ``instructions`` and ``speed`` say whether the
engine honours those OpenAI parameters. ``max_input_chars`` bounds ``input``.
AudioSpeechApi.title: AudioSpeechApi

AudioTranscriptionApi.description:
A route serving ``POST /v1/audio/transcriptions``: one audio upload in.

The input is audio by mode, so the block has no modalities or token limits.
``max_file_bytes`` and ``max_audio_seconds`` are the engine's own upload and
decode limits (``null``: the engine states no duration limit); ``languages``
are the ISO 639-1 values of OpenAI's ``language`` parameter the engine
accepts. ``prompt`` and ``temperature`` say whether the engine honours those
OpenAI parameters; no ``timestamp_granularities`` means none are offered.
AudioTranscriptionApi.title: AudioTranscriptionApi

CatalogVocabulary.description: The words of one release, as the index publishes them.
CatalogVocabulary.title: CatalogVocabulary

DecisionApi.description: A route serving ``POST /v1/systemone``; it has no chat-shaped facts.
DecisionApi.title: DecisionApi

GitHubLfsSource.description:
Git LFS objects at one commit of a canonical public GitHub repository.

Every model file is one LFS object: its ``sha256`` is the LFS oid, its
``size_bytes`` the LFS size, and its ``path`` the file's path in the
repository at ``revision`` (the full commit SHA). The bytes are fetched by
oid and verified at ingress; the commit and path record where the binding
of path to oid was read.
GitHubLfsSource.title: GitHubLfsSource

GitHubReleaseAsset.description: One GitHub release asset selected for an existing model file.
GitHubReleaseAsset.title: GitHubReleaseAsset

GitHubReleaseSource.description: An exact asset from one release in a canonical GitHub repository.
GitHubReleaseSource.title: GitHubReleaseSource

ModelDefinition.description: One exact model version and variant, including its complete manifest.
ModelDefinition.title: ModelDefinition

ModelFile.description:
One entry in the complete immutable model file manifest.

``sha256`` and ``size_bytes`` always describe the whole installed file.
When the source publishes the file only as split parts, ``parts`` lists
them in joining order (byte concatenation yields the file). Omitted means
the source publishes the file whole, so the same bytes have the same
identity whether the source splits them or not.
ModelFile.title: ModelFile

ModelFilePart.description:
One published piece of a file the source can only host split.

A part is a transport detail: it exists only at the source (for example a
Hugging Face repository that caps files at 50 GB publishes
``model.safetensors.part00``). It is never installed.
ModelFilePart.title: ModelFilePart

ModelIdentity.description: The family, logical model, exact version, and selected variant.
ModelIdentity.title: ModelIdentity

PackageContract.description: How a consumer finds and checks the package of each recipe entry.
PackageContract.title: PackageContract

PrebuiltImage.description: The CI-built runtime image of exactly this recipe revision.
PrebuiltImage.title: PrebuiltImage

PublishedMeasuredMemory.description:
A catalog entry's sibling key ``measured_memory``: roles of exactly its content.

Never part of :class:`PublishedQualificationStatusView`, which forbids unknown
fields: an older Controller reads the status unchanged and ignores this key.
PublishedMeasuredMemory.title: PublishedMeasuredMemory

PublishedRoleMemory.description:
What one role of one content measured on hardware, as the catalog carries it.

``measured_peak_bytes`` is information: the role's workload bytes (the
observed Spark use less the OS floor), never the recipe's declaration.
``peak_bytes`` is the one value admission reads: the measured peak, or, when
that exceeds the admission maximum (``exceeds_admission_maximum``), the
role's declared peak. The Controller admits on ``peak_bytes`` and, for the
flagged case, shows a warning that hardware measured more than it can admit.
PublishedRoleMemory.title: PublishedRoleMemory

enum: Model output differed from the expected answer
Carried from the identical document before the display split
Carried from the identical execution document before the Model facts split
QualificationQualityNote.title: QualificationQualityNote

enum: Recipe runtime exceeded available memory; needs fix
Model content integrity check failed; needs fix
Recipe definition or build policy check failed; needs fix
QualificationSummary.title: QualificationSummary

enum: historical platform or runtime identity unavailable
QualificationUnverifiedReason.title: QualificationUnverifiedReason

RecipeApiOptionChoice.description: The complete block that applies when ``option`` is set to ``value``.
RecipeApiOptionChoice.title: RecipeApiOptionChoice

RecipeDefinition.description: The sole public recipe authoring contract.
RecipeDefinition.title: RecipeDefinition

RecipeExecution.description: The platform builds every recipe image from its pinned base and context.
RecipeExecution.title: RecipeExecution

RecipeJobServingRequest.description: A job check stages its fixture as the input when the interface has one.
RecipeJobServingRequest.title: RecipeJobServingRequest

RecipeMemoryResources.description: Unified (DGX Spark) memory one role needs.
RecipeMemoryResources.title: RecipeMemoryResources

RecipeMultipartServingRequest.description: ``POST /v1/audio/transcriptions``: form fields plus one staged audio file.
RecipeMultipartServingRequest.title: RecipeMultipartServingRequest

RecipeOption.description:
A recipe-declared setting with a fixed set of named values.

Users pick one of the enumerated choices; there are no free-form values.
Exactly one choice is the default and applies whenever nothing is chosen.
RecipeOption.title: RecipeOption

RecipeOptionChoice.description:
One named value of an option, with the runtime changes it selects.

``args`` replace a base runtime argument of the same name in place, or are
appended after the base arguments; ``env`` does the same for environment
variables. Both go through the checks of ``runtime.arguments`` and
``runtime.environment``, and the platform applies its own security, mount
and port rules to the merged result.
RecipeOptionChoice.title: RecipeOptionChoice

RecipeRelease.description:
The version this recipe runs.

When the upstream project publishes versions, this is the upstream version
and its release date (for example ``1.6`` released 2026-09-17). A recipe
whose upstream has no versions carries its own semantic version instead.
The recipe library's own version follows the contract, not recipe content.
RecipeRelease.title: RecipeRelease

value.description: A literal process value; null is reserved for the setting-bound placeholder.

RecipeTopology.description:
Roles and their start order; everything else follows from node_count.

One node runs alone. More nodes share one connected fabric: losing a rank
withdraws the endpoint, recovery restarts the workers and then the
entrypoint, and stopping always starts with the endpoint owner.
RecipeTopology.title: RecipeTopology
